RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the July 27, 2005/Sravana 5, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Surrender policy of Government for
militants
*41. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the surrender policy of Government
for members of militant/terrorist outfits
who eschew violence and intend to return
to the mainstream civil society;
(b) whether it is uniform in all the
affected States or is at variance from one
State to another;
(c) whether distinctions, if any, are made
between surrendering members belonging
to outfits which have been operating at the
behest of or linked to foreign espionage
agencies and those who took to arms in
pursuance of extremist ideological doctrines
and/or to fight against policies of
Government perceived to be unjust;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Threat of terrorist attacks
*42. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the threat of terrorist attacks on national
monuments and temple townships; and
(b) the steps proposed to meet the
threat and protect places of national
importance and religious worship?
Inquiry points pertaining to SPS
*43. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Department of Commerce
has finalized three inquiry points pertaining
to Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary (SPS)
measures  that would handle all queries or
comments on SPS notification/regulation
issued by other member countries of the
World Trade Organization;
(b) whether the three inquiry points
would be Department of Agriculture and
Cooperation for plant protection, Ministry
of Health for food safety and the
Department of Animal Husbandry and
Dairying for animal products; and
(c) if so, what is the outcome of the
steps taken in this regard?

14
Electricity shortage in the country
*44. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether facing coal and gas shortage,
Government are now focusing on hydro
electricity for generating sustainable power
to tide over electricity shortage in the
country;
(b) whether Power Ministry are facing
coal and gas shortage for power plants;
(c) whether Minister has said that hydel
potential needed to be exploited for
electrifying all villages households by 2012;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to see that all villages are
electrified by 2012 and to what extent
Government have been able to achieve this
target?
Terrorist attack in Ayodhya
†*45. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorists
recently attacked Ram Janm Bhumi in
Ayodhya;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of persons killed and
injured in the terrorist attack;
(d) whether any one has taken the
responsibility for the attack;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) whether Government propose to
take stringent steps to prevent the
recurrence of such incidents; and
(g) if so, the details thereof?
Coordination in poverty alleviation
schemes
†*46. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for alleviating
poverty in rural areas of the country it is
necessary to remove unemployment;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
many schemes are being run by
Government at present for providing
employment opportunities;
(c) whether it is also a fact that people
are not getting desired benefits of these
schemes in the absence of mutual
coordination among all the schemes; and
(d) if so, the details of corrective steps
Government propose to take for proper
implementation of the said schemes?
Indo-US MoU on military medicine
*47. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India and the United States
signed a MoU for training and academic
cooperation in military medicine that will
open up new frontiers in research and
education for armed forces of both the
countries;
(b) if so, the main aims and objects of
the MoU;
(c) to what extent US has agreed to help
and assist India in health and research in
the Army; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

15
(d) by when the implementation of the
MoU is likely to start?
Foreign aid
†*48. SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the report namely "Aid
real Aid" of the voluntary institution
'Action Aid', as per this report the aid
coming from abroad is merely illusionary
and major part of them goes in the payment
of items like consultancy, buying machinery
etc. to the aid giving countries;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the amount of foreign aid received
during last three years and the amount that
spent out of them on the different items of
consultancy etc. and the amount of aid that
was actually used?
Escape of under-trials from Tihar Jail
*49. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether ten under-trials escaped
from the court complex at Tihar Jail, Delhi
on the 6th July, 2005;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these under-trials have since
been traced and arrested;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether any action has been taken
against the security personnel responsible
for this escape of under-trials from Tihar
Jail;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) the total number of under-trials/
prisoners escaped from Tihar Jail during
the last three years, year-wise and how
many of them were later traced and arrested
each year?
Lives lost due to violence
*50. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of lives lost as a result of
naxalite/insurgency/terrorist violence in
different parts of the country during the
last three years and till-date, State-wise;
(b) the number of lives of various
security forces lost in the country during
this period, State-wise; and
(c) the effective measures taken by
Government to tackle terrorism on its own?
Introduction of bar code and RF in
textile sector
*51. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Ministry have any plan to
bring bar code and radio frequency
technologies under the ambit of Technology
Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS);
(b) whether it is a fact that the textile
exporters are also demanding the same for
sometime now in the Post-Quota regime;
and
(c) if so, how bar coding and radio
frequency technologies help in increase,
maintenance and quality and identification
of product by exporters?
Adverse effect of import of arecanut
*52. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

16
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) the total quantity of arecanut
imported by the country during the last
three years from Bangladesh, Thailand, Sri
Lanka and Myanmar, year-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that import of
arecanut from these countries has resulted
in fall in the prices of arecanut hitting the
arecanut growers of Karnataka adversely;
(c) whether Central Government
propose to stop the import of arecanut in
order to safeguard the interests of arecanut
growers of Karnataka;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the steps taken to safeguard the
interests of arecanut growers of Karnataka?
Revival of separatist/terrorist groups
†*53. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have received the information regarding
terrorist and separatist groups becoming
active again after uniting together in several
States recently;
(b) if so, the names of these terrorist
organizations and the States where activities
of these organizations have spread so far;
and
(c) the number of violent incidents
carried out by these terrorist groups by the
end of June, 2005 in those States?
Decline in youth joining the Army
†*54. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether his Ministry have
conducted a survey to ascertain the reasons
for decline in the tendency among youths
to join Army; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Increase of tourists in Kashmir
†*55. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether number of tourists have
increased following decrease in terrorist
activities in Kashmir;
(b) if so, the year-wise details of last
three years;
(c) whether tour of Kashmir is safe for
the tourists; and
(d) if so, the details of the measures
adopted by Government for security of
tourists?
Services negotiations at WTO
*56. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
submitted its revised offers or going to
submit the same in the services negotiations
at the WTO where initial offers were made
in 2003; and
(b) what is the flexibility that the
Ministry is thinking that it has to move
forward in services negotiations which will
help India in the forth-coming meeting of
WTO?
Recommendations of Review
Committee on POTA
*57. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:

17
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Review Committee of POTA has submitted
a report on POTA accused in Godhra
incident;
(b) what are the recommendations of
this Committee; and
(c) what action has been taken to
implement this report?
Export of adulterated chillies
*58. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
ascertained the facts regarding reported
export of adulterated chillies, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether Government have taken up
the issue on behalf of Indian exporters, if
so, what steps are taken, if not, the reasons
therefor;
(c) whether WTO agreements provide
for sanitary-standards, if so, are they
standardised, if so, the details thereof, if
not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government have also
ascertained that the sanitary- standards are
not used as non-tariff barriers against agro-
exports from developing countries, if so,
the details thereof?
Shortage of coal in Thermal Power
Stations
*59. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of thermal power stations in the country
have been facing an acute shortage of coal
and a number of them are facing immediate
closure;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the remedial steps Government
propose to take in that direction?
Installed power generation capacity in
Assam
*60. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the present annual installed power
generation capacity in the State of Assam
and the actual generation in the State with
the details thereof during the last three
years;
(b) whether it is a fact that there is an
acute shortage of power in the State;
and
(c) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 21st July, 2005 Secretary-General.

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the July 27, 2005/Sravana 5, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —105
Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreement with
Singapore
229. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a
Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement was recently signed with the
Singapore Government;
(b) what will be the impact of this
Agreement on trading of items in the
Negative List like liquor, beer etc.; and
(c) what are the details thereof?
Import of cheap products
†230. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
cheap products, which have heavy subsidy
from various developed countries are being
imported and dumped in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
formulated any strategy to check cheap
imports with a view to protecting the
interests of domestic industry and the
farmers;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor and by
when arrangements would be made
therefor?
Permission to visit Sharda Mata
Shrine
231. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has received representations from
organisations of Kashmiri Pandit for
visiting Sharda Mata Shrine located in PoK;
(b) if so, the steps taken by the
Ministry in this regard;
(c) whether there is any possibility to
grant permission to Kashmiri Pandits for
visiting Sharda Mata Shrine in near future;
and
(d) if so, the timeframe thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

53
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
India-Singapore MoU
232. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Singapore have
signed a Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreement;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the fears of Indian
companies about Chinese goods entering
India at concessional duty through
Singapore has been allayed and if so, the
safeguards adopted to protect the domestic
industry from third country imports; and
(d) the extent to which this MoU would
benefit India in boosting its trade?
Export of Alphanso Mango to China
†233. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have permitted to export the 'alphanso'
variety of mango to China;
(b) whether it is also a fact that China
intend to import grapes, pomegranate, lady
finger, bitter gourd and other vegetables from
India;
(c) if so, whether Government are
contemplating on according its sanction for
the export thereof;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Export of Alphanso Mangoes
†234. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Australia,
Japan, New Zealand and America have
expressed their intention to import Hapus
(Alphanso) mango which is somewhat
vapour heat treated;
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to allow export of Hapus
mango to these countries;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Foreign investment in UP
†235. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the targets fixed for foreign
investment in Uttar Pradesh during the last
three years under the liberalisation policy
alongwith the achievements thereof;
(b) the targets fixed for the foreign
investment during the forthcoming five
years; and
(c) the steps taken by the Government
for achieving the target?
Industrial Development Centres in
the country
†236. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Industrial
Development Centres in the country as on
the last month and the number of Industrial

54
Development Centres in Uttar Pradesh out
of the above;
(b) the amount provided by the Central
Government to the Industrial Development
Centres of Uttar Pradesh during the last
three years; and
(c) the number of Industrial
Development Centres proposed to be set
up in this financial year alongwith the
locations thereof?
Made in India Exhibition in Lahore,
Pakistan
237. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ministry of
Commerce is planning to organize a 'made
in India' exhibition in Lahore, Pakistan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government of Pakistan has allowed only
exhibition of products to be displayed at
the expo, and not granted permission for
on the spot sale of all products;
(d) if so, whether Government propose
to ask Pakistan Government to reconsider
and allow on the spot sale of all products;
and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Asian Economic Community
238. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently India
has espoused vision of an Asian Economic
Community, like the European Union,
which would encompass the ASEAN,
Japan, China, South Korea and India, to
help achieve economic integration of the
region to drive Asia's emergence as the
epicenter of global economy; and
(b) if so, the details of views expressed,
if any, by other Asian countries and further
initiatives taken/proposed to be taken to
carve out a viable regional economic union?
Mizoram as a Gateway to ASEAN
nations
239. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Mizoram is
all set to become a gateway to ASEAN
nations;
(b) which are the other centers for trade
with ASEAN in the NE region;
(c) what are the main exchangeable items
across the borders; and
(d) how far will this help to improve
the economy of the NE Region?
Rising Trade Deficit
240. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the trade deficit has been
rising from $ 15 billion in 2003-04 to $ 30
billion in 2004-05 indicating that our
exports have been significantly falling
behind imports;
(b) whether the exports of more labour
intensive products like textiles and food
products increases employment whereas
the reserve goes for imports;
(c) whether in China exports have been
running ahead of imports inspite of the
increase in oil price; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
remedy the rising trade deficit?

55
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Increase in Import
†241. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in comparison
to export, import is increasing continuously
during the past years in the country;
(b) if so, the difference between import
and export during the year 2004-05 and
after the first three months of year
2005-2006;
(c) whether it is also a fact that number
of those items are imported in the country
which are exported as well; and
(d) if so, the names of these items and
the reasons for importing such items which
are exported as well?
Promotion of Business with USA,
China and Russia
242. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have explored
further possibilities to promote business
with U.S.A., China and Russia during the
last three months;
(b) if so, the names of items whose
export and import is possible with these
countries; and
(c) the other areas where business can
be promoted and the facilities proposed to
be provided by Government to Indian
businessmen for this purpose?
Sanitary and Phytosanitary Standards
for agro and farm products
243. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the WTO agreement
provide for Sanitary and Phytosanitary
standards for agro and farm products;
(b) if so, what is the mechanism to
prescribe such standards;
(c) what are the guarantees to avoid such
standards from being used as non-tariff
barriers; and
(d) what steps are being taken to enhance
Sanitary and Phytosanitary standards of
the country's exports?
International diamond trading centre
in India
244. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is thinking of setting up of International
diamond trading centre in India;
(b) whether it is also a fact that India is
the largest buyer of diamond roughs in the
world;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government are thinking
of allowing FDI in the diamond exploration;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

56
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Export of medicines to America
†245. DR. CHHATTRAPAL SINGH
LODHA:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to export medicines to America;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there has been any dialogue
between the two countries in this regard;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
FDI proposals for Nagaland
246. SHRI T.R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of foreign direct
investment proposals in the State of
Nagaland received by Government during
the last three years;
(b) the details of projects and the area
of such projects approved for US, Russia,
Japan and China; and
(c) the details of total amount invested
in the State of Nagaland for setting up of
various industries?
Private investment from India in
Pakistan
247. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of Pakistan
has recently allowed private investment
from India in various fields;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the private investors allowed to invest and
the activities in which these investments
are proposed to be allowed; and
(c) whether the Government of India
has given green signal to such investments?
Review of anti-dumping duty on
shrimp import by US
248. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether US International Trade
Commission announced its decision to hold
"changed circumstances reviews" on its
January decision to impose anti-dumping
duty on shrimp import from India and
Thailand;
(b) whether a fresh assessment of laws
was being made;
(c) whether US ITC has decided to send
experts to India to assess the damage caused
to shrimp export business;
(d) if so, what are the reports made by
them; and
(e) to what exent US's decision to revive
anti-dumping duty on shrimp has been
decided upon?
Guidelines set by Trade and Economic
Relations Committee
249. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Trade and Economic
Relations Committee headed by Prime
Minister met in the month of June and

57
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
decided to set guidelines for future trade
negotiations and enhancing flow in the
country;
(b) if so, whether in the meeting the
Commerce Minister presented a current
status and future roadmap for a host of
possible FTAs and RTAs to the Trade and
Economic Relations Committee; and
(c) if so, what other decisions were
taken by the Committee and what steps
are being taken to implement them?
Foreign trade under FTAs
†250. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foreign trade
with several other countries of the world is
done on the basis of Free Trade Agreements;
(b) if so, the names of the countries
with which foreign trade of India is going
on till date under Free Trade Agreements;
and
(c) the value of export and import in
terms of money during the year 2004-05
and during first three months of 2005-06
separately with each country?
Joint Business Council between India
and Pakistan
251. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is true that Pakistan
endorsed India's proposal for setting up of
a Joint Business Council for greater
economic cooperation between the two
countries;
(b) whether the issue of granting MFN
status to India has come up when the
Pakistan Commerce Minister came to India
recently; and
(c) if so, and the details thereof and the
reasons for not granting MFN status to
India by Pakistan?
Fall in coffee price
252. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that coffee prices
in the international market have fallen
drastically thereby creating a lot of problems
for coffee growers;
(b) if so, the special package announced
by the Central Government for coffee
growers;
(c) whether the coffee growers have
alleged that correct information of the
scheme has not been communicated to them
by the concerned authorities;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the corrective measures taken to help
the coffee growers in this regard?
Backlog of vacancies of SC, ST and
OBC
253. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of backlog of vacancies of
SCs, STs and OBCs separately in his
Ministry and its subordinate offices as on
30th June, 2005, category-wise; and
(b) the necessary steps being taken by
Government to fill up these vacant posts
of the above-mentioned categories?

58
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Demand of Export Promotion
Councils
254. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various
Export Promotion Councils urged
